verdict.rationale: Linear ships Loops, recurring agent automations that run on a schedule or on events (linear-docs-36, linear-docs-95). Author name indicators show when text was added by a loop (linear-docs-34), and content can be restored to any previous checkpoint from version history (linear-docs-35). That lets users review and undo what a loop wrote, but nothing shows versioning, review or rollback of the loop definitions themselves. Missing for 10: version history for loop or automation definitions, review/approval of automation changes before they take effect, rollback of an automation's configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
